fr.R: Tout le monde dans la foule essayait de toucher Jésus. Une puissance sortait de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et elle les guérissait tous.

sw.L: Na umati wote ulikuwa ukitafuta kumgusa, kwa sababu nguvu ilikuwa ikitoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} na kuwaponya wote.
sw.B: Kila mtu katika umati alijaribu kumgusa, kwa kuwa nguvu ilitoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, ikawaponya wote.
sw.R: Kila mtu katika umati alijaribu kumgusa Yesu. Nguvu ilikuwa ikitoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, nayo ikawaponya wote.

vi.L: Và cả đoàn dân đều tìm cách chạm vào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì có quyền năng từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra và chữa lành mọi người.
vi.B: Mọi người trong đoàn dân đều cố chạm vào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì có quyền năng từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tuôn ra và chữa lành hết thảy họ.
vi.R: Mọi người trong đám đông đều cố chạm vào Đức Giê-xu. Quyền năng từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tuôn ra, và quyền năng ấy chữa lành tất cả họ.

ko.L: 그리고 온 무리가 그분을 만지려고 애쓰고 있었다. 능력이 그분에게서 나와서 모든 사람을 고치고 있었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 무리는 모두 예수께 손을 대려고 애썼다. 예수께로부터 능력이 나와서 그들을 모두 고쳐 주었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 사람들은 모두 예수를 만지려고 했다. 예수께로부터 능력이 나와서 그들을 모두 낫게 했기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: power: God's power at work through Jesus
alternatives: magic in his body or clothes
decisions.reason: The power of the Lord was with Jesus to heal (5:17). In 8:46 he feels power go out from him when a woman touches him in faith.

decisions.choice: were seeking ... was going out ... was healing: a scene that went on and on
decisions.reason: The verbs describe what kept happening all through that time.

source.text: Καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπάρας τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ εἰς τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ ἔλεγεν· Μακάριοι οἱ πτωχοί, ὅτι ὑμετέρα ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And he having lifted up the eyes of him to the disciples of him was saying, Blessed the poor, for yours is the kingdom of the God.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}, lifting up {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} eyes to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples, was saying, "Blessed [are] the poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.
en.B: Then, with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} eyes on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "Blessed are you poor, for the kingdom of God is yours.
en.R: Jesus looked at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples and said, "How blessed you are, you who are poor! The kingdom of God belongs to you.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, alzando {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ojos hacia {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos, decía: «Dichosos los pobres, porque {{plural_you:de ustedes|vuestro}} es el reino de Dios.
es.B: Entonces, con la mirada puesta en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos, dijo: «Dichosos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} los pobres, porque el reino de Dios es {{plural_you:de ustedes|vuestro}}.
es.R: Jesús miró a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos y les dijo: «¡Qué dichosos {{plural_you:son ustedes|sois vosotros}}, los que {{plural_you:son|sois}} pobres! El reino de Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} pertenece.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, levant {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} yeux vers {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples, disait : « Heureux les pauvres, car c’est à vous qu’est le royaume de Dieu.
fr.B: Alors, les yeux fixés sur {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « Heureux, vous les pauvres, car le royaume de Dieu vous appartient.
fr.R: Jésus a regardé {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit : « Vous êtes heureux, vous qui êtes pauvres ! Le royaume de Dieu est à vous.

sw.L: Naye, akiinua macho {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kuwatazama wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, alikuwa akisema, "Heri maskini, kwa sababu ufalme wa Mungu ni wenu.
sw.B: Kisha aliwatazama wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, akasema, "Heri yenu ninyi maskini, kwa kuwa ufalme wa Mungu ni wenu.
sw.R: Yesu aliwatazama wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, akasema, "Heri yenu ninyi mlio maskini! Ufalme wa Mungu ni mali yenu.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, ngước mắt nhìn các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nói: "Phước cho những người nghèo, vì vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời là của các con.
vi.B: Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đưa mắt nhìn các môn đồ và nói: "Phước cho các con là những người nghèo, vì vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời thuộc về các con.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nhìn các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nói: "Các con là người nghèo thật có phước! Vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời thuộc về các con.

ko.L: 그리고 그분은 그분의 제자들을 향하여 눈을 들어 말씀하고 계셨다. "가난한 사람들은 복이 있다. 하나님의 나라가 너희의 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 예수께서 제자들을 바라보시며 말씀하셨다. "가난한 너희는 복이 있다. 하나님의 나라가 너희의 것이기 때문이다.
ko.R: 예수께서 제자들을 바라보시며 말씀하셨다. "가난한 너희는 얼마나 복된 사람들이냐! 하나님의 나라가 너희 것이다.

decisions.choice: blessed: fortunate, in a happy state because of God's favor
alternatives: blessed by God, the word of 1:42
decisions.reason: The word is the one of 1:45. It declares people fortunate in God's eyes; it is neither a wish nor a command. "Happy" would sound like a passing feeling.

decisions.choice: the poor: people who are really poor, and who look to God for help
decisions.reason: Luke has no "in spirit" (compare Matthew 5:3). Jesus came to bring good news to the poor (4:18, from Isaiah 61:1). In the Psalms the poor are those who have no help but God (Psalm 34:7).

decisions.choice: the poor ... yours: Jesus speaks of the poor and to them in the same breath
decisions.reason: The saying begins in the third person and turns to "you". The disciples before him are among the poor he means (5:11, 28).

decisions.choice: the kingdom of God: God's rule, already breaking in through Jesus and still to come in full
decisions.reason: Jesus announces the kingdom (4:43). It belongs now to the poor, as a promise and a present gift.

decisions.choice: you poor (B); you who are poor (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow the turn to "you" from the start, so the saying reads as spoken to the disciples.

decisions.choice: How blessed you are
decisions.reason: Readable makes the declaration an exclamation, which is how it sounds.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and runs on to 6:49, with a break only for the narrator's words at 6:39
decisions.reason: The sermon is one long speech.

decisions.choice: dichosos, at every level
decisions.reason: The term used across the New Testament drafts: "dichoso" is the everyday word for someone in a fortunate, happy state because of God's favor (meaning decision m1); "bienaventurado" is the older church word. Readable keeps the same word with "¡Qué ...!", as the English Readable says "How blessed". The same through 6:22.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:de ustedes|vuestro}}
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks of the poor and to them in one breath (meaning decision m3). "Suyo" could be read as "theirs" and hide the turn to "you", so the ustedes form spells it out.

decisions.choice: Heureux (L, B); Vous êtes heureux (R), for all four beatitudes (6:20-22)
decisions.reason: "Heureux" is the usual French word for the beatitudes and says the happy state of those God favours (m1); "bienheureux" now sounds churchly or suggests the blessed in heaven. Readable makes it a plain exclamation, as the English Readable does. "Le royaume de Dieu" is the term sheet's form.

decisions.choice: Heri (L); Heri yenu (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term used across the New Testament drafts: "heri" is the settled word for the state of those God favors (meaning decision m1). "Heri yenu" addresses the hearers, as Jesus does (meaning decision m3). The same through 6:22.

decisions.choice: "Phước cho" (L, B); "thật có phước" (R) for "blessed" (6:20-23)
decisions.reason: "phước" is the Protestant word for God's favor and the happiness it brings, as in John 20:29 and Luke 1:45; "hạnh phúc" names a feeling, which says less than the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: Jesus speaks to his disciples as "các con" through 6:20-23 and 6:27-49
decisions.reason: Luke says Jesus looks at his disciples as he speaks; the form settled for the Gospels for Jesus teaching his disciples is "các con".

decisions.choice: "복이 있다" (L, B); "얼마나 복된 사람들이냐" (R) for makarios, through 6:22 and at 7:23
decisions.reason: The word means fortunate because of God's favor (meaning decision); "복이 있다" says that in a modern ending, as Luke 1:45 and John 13:17 do in Korean. Readable turns it into an exclamation, as the English Readable does ("How blessed you are").

decisions.choice: "가난한 사람들은 ... 너희의 것" (L); "가난한 너희는" (B, R); "하나님의 나라" at every level
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks of the poor and to them in the same breath (meaning decision); Literal keeps the shift, Balanced and Readable say "you" throughout, as the English does. "하나님의 나라" is the term of Mark and Luke 4:43 in Korean.

source.text: μακάριοι οἱ πεινῶντες νῦν, ὅτι χορτασθήσεσθε.

records.literal_gloss: Blessed the hungering now, for you will be filled.

en.L: Blessed [are] those who hunger now, for you will be filled.
en.B: Blessed are you who are hungry now, for you will eat your fill.
en.R: How blessed you are, you who are hungry now! God will give you plenty to eat.

es.L: Dichosos los que ahora tienen hambre, porque {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} saciados.
es.B: Dichosos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} los que ahora {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} hambre, porque {{plural_you:quedarán|quedaréis}} satisfechos.
es.R: ¡Qué dichosos {{plural_you:son ustedes|sois vosotros}}, los que ahora {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} hambre! Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} dará comida en abundancia.

fr.L: Heureux ceux qui ont faim maintenant, car vous serez rassasiés.
fr.B: Heureux, vous qui avez faim maintenant, car vous mangerez à votre faim.
fr.R: Vous êtes heureux, vous qui avez faim maintenant ! Dieu vous donnera beaucoup à manger.

sw.L: Heri wenye njaa sasa, kwa sababu mtashibishwa.
sw.B: Heri yenu ninyi mlio na njaa sasa, kwa kuwa mtashiba.
sw.R: Heri yenu ninyi mlio na njaa sasa! Mungu atawapa chakula cha kutosha.

vi.L: Phước cho những người bây giờ đang đói, vì các con sẽ được no đủ.
vi.B: Phước cho các con là những người bây giờ đang đói, vì các con sẽ được no nê.
vi.R: Các con là người bây giờ đang đói thật có phước! Đức Chúa Trời sẽ cho các con ăn no đủ.

ko.L: 지금 굶주리는 사람들은 복이 있다. 너희가 배부르게 될 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 지금 굶주리는 너희는 복이 있다. 너희가 배불리 먹게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 지금 배고픈 너희는 얼마나 복된 사람들이냐! 하나님께서 너희를 배불리 먹이실 것이다.

decisions.choice: you will be filled: God will fill you
alternatives: you will find food for yourselves
decisions.reason: The passive leaves God unnamed, as Jewish speech often did. Mary sang that God fills the hungry with good things (1:53; Psalm 107:9).

decisions.choice: those who hunger now: people who really go hungry in this life
alternatives: those who hunger for righteousness only
decisions.reason: Luke has no "for righteousness" (compare Matthew 5:6). The word "now" sets their present need against God's coming reversal.

decisions.choice: God will give you
decisions.reason: Readable names God, as the meaning decision explains.

source.text: μακάριοι οἱ κλαίοντες νῦν, ὅτι γελάσετε.

records.literal_gloss: Blessed the weeping now, for you will laugh.

en.L: Blessed [are] those who weep now, for you will laugh.
en.B: Blessed are those of you who are in tears now, for you will laugh.
en.R: How blessed you are, you who are crying now! The day will come when you laugh.

es.L: Dichosos los que ahora lloran, porque {{plural_you:reirán|reiréis}}.
es.B: Dichosos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} los que ahora {{plural_you:lloran|lloráis}}, porque {{plural_you:reirán|reiréis}}.
es.R: ¡Qué dichosos {{plural_you:son ustedes|sois vosotros}}, los que ahora {{plural_you:lloran|lloráis}}! Llegará el día en que {{plural_you:reirán|reiréis}}.

fr.L: Heureux ceux qui pleurent maintenant, car vous rirez.
fr.B: Heureux, vous qui êtes dans les larmes maintenant, car vous rirez.
fr.R: Vous êtes heureux, vous qui pleurez maintenant ! Un jour viendra où vous rirez.

sw.L: Heri wanaolia sasa, kwa sababu mtacheka.
sw.B: Heri yenu ninyi mnaolia sasa, kwa kuwa mtacheka.
sw.R: Heri yenu ninyi mnaolia sasa! Siku itakuja ambapo mtacheka.

vi.L: Phước cho những người bây giờ đang khóc, vì các con sẽ cười.
vi.B: Phước cho các con là những người bây giờ đang khóc lóc, vì các con sẽ được vui cười.
vi.R: Các con là người bây giờ đang khóc thật có phước! Sẽ có ngày các con được vui cười.

ko.L: 지금 우는 사람들은 복이 있다. 너희가 웃을 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 지금 우는 너희는 복이 있다. 너희가 웃게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 지금 우는 너희는 얼마나 복된 사람들이냐! 너희가 웃을 날이 올 것이다.

decisions.choice: weep ... laugh: deep grief, and the joy of God's reversal
decisions.reason: Weeping is loud grief, as for the dead (8:52). Laughter here is the joy of people whose fortunes God has turned (Psalm 126:1-2).

decisions.choice: The day will come when
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the laughter lies ahead, as the future tense says.

source.text: Μακάριοί ἐστε ὅταν μισήσωσιν ὑμᾶς οἱ ἄνθρωποι, καὶ ὅταν ἀφορίσωσιν ὑμᾶς καὶ ὀνειδίσωσιν καὶ ἐκβάλωσιν τὸ ὄνομα ὑμῶν ὡς πονηρὸν ἕνεκα τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου·

records.literal_gloss: Blessed are you when hate you the men, and when they exclude you and insult and cast out the name of you as evil on account of the Son of the Man;

en.L: Blessed are you when {{gender:people|men}} hate you, and when they exclude you and insult [you] and cast out your name as evil on account of the Son of Man.
en.B: Blessed are you when {{gender:people|men}} hate you and push you out of their company, when they insult you and throw out your name as something evil, all because of the Son of Man.
en.R: How blessed you are when {{gender:people|men}} hate you because of the Son of Man! They may shut you out and insult you. They may treat your very name as something evil.

es.L: Dichosos {{plural_you:son|sois}} cuando {{gender:las personas|los hombres}} {{plural_you:los|os}} odien, y cuando {{plural_you:los|os}} excluyan y [{{plural_you:los|os}}] insulten y desechen {{plural_you:el nombre de ustedes|vuestro nombre}} como malo por causa del Hijo del Hombre.
es.B: Dichosos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} cuando {{gender:las personas|los hombres}} {{plural_you:los|os}} odien y {{plural_you:los|os}} aparten de su compañía, cuando {{plural_you:los|os}} insulten y desprecien {{plural_you:el nombre de ustedes|vuestro nombre}} como algo malo, todo por causa del Hijo del Hombre.
es.R: ¡Qué dichosos {{plural_you:son ustedes|sois vosotros}} cuando {{gender:las personas|los hombres}} {{plural_you:los|os}} odien por causa del Hijo del Hombre! Puede que {{plural_you:los|os}} echen de su lado y {{plural_you:los|os}} insulten. Puede que traten hasta {{plural_you:el nombre de ustedes|vuestro nombre}} como algo malo.

fr.L: Heureux êtes-vous quand les {{gender:gens|hommes}} vous haïront, et quand ils vous excluront, et [vous] insulteront, et rejetteront votre nom comme mauvais, à cause du Fils de l’homme.
fr.B: Heureux êtes-vous quand les {{gender:gens|hommes}} vous haïront, quand ils vous tiendront à l’écart, qu’ils vous insulteront et rejetteront votre nom comme quelque chose de mauvais, à cause du Fils de l’homme.
fr.R: Vous êtes heureux quand les {{gender:gens|hommes}} vous détestent à cause du Fils de l’homme ! Il se peut qu’ils vous rejettent et qu’ils vous insultent. Ils traiteront peut-être votre nom même comme quelque chose de mauvais.

sw.L: Heri ninyi watu watakapowachukia, na watakapowatenga na kuwatukana na kulitupa nje jina lenu kama ovu kwa ajili ya Mwana wa Adamu.
sw.B: Heri yenu watu wanapowachukia na kuwatenga, wanapowatukana na kulitupa jina lenu kama kitu kiovu, kwa sababu ya Mwana wa Adamu.
sw.R: Heri yenu watu wanapowachukia kwa sababu ya Mwana wa Adamu! Huenda wakawatenga na kuwatukana. Huenda wakalihesabu hata jina lenu kuwa kitu kiovu.

vi.L: Phước cho các con khi người ta ghét các con, và khi họ loại các con ra, sỉ nhục [các con], và bỏ tên các con như đồ xấu xa, vì cớ Con Người.
vi.B: Phước cho các con khi người ta ghét các con, xua đuổi các con khỏi cộng đồng của họ, khi họ sỉ nhục các con và gạt bỏ tên các con như một điều xấu xa, chỉ vì Con Người.
vi.R: Các con thật có phước khi người ta ghét các con vì Con Người! Có thể họ sẽ đuổi các con đi và sỉ nhục các con. Có thể họ sẽ coi chính tên của các con là điều xấu xa.

ko.L: 사람들이 너희를 미워할 때, 그리고 인자 때문에 너희를 따돌리고 욕하고 너희 이름을 악한 것으로 내버릴 때, 너희는 복이 있다.
ko.B: 인자 때문에 사람들이 너희를 미워하고, 너희를 자기들 가운데서 쫓아내고, 너희를 모욕하고, 너희 이름을 악한 것처럼 내칠 때, 너희는 복이 있다.
ko.R: 인자 때문에 사람들이 너희를 미워할 때, 너희는 얼마나 복된 사람들이냐! 사람들은 너희를 따돌리고 욕할지도 모른다. 너희 이름을 나쁜 것처럼 여길지도 모른다.

decisions.choice: exclude: separate, shut out from the community
decisions.reason: The verb means to mark off. It may include being put out of the synagogue (John 9:22; 16:2).

decisions.choice: cast out your name as evil: reject you as wicked, treating your name as a byword
alternatives: erase your name from a list
decisions.reason: The name stands for the person. It may also mean the name they bear as followers of Jesus (Acts 11:26; 1 Peter 4:14-16).

decisions.choice: on account of the Son of Man: because they belong to Jesus
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks of himself by the title he uses in 6:5. His followers will suffer because they are his.

decisions.choice: push you out of their company (B); shut you out (R)
decisions.reason: Plain words for being cut off from others.

decisions.choice: the reason first, then the ways they are mistreated, as possibilities
decisions.reason: Readable puts the cause up front and breaks the list into short sentences.

decisions.choice: {{gender:las personas|los hombres}}
decisions.reason: Spanish has the same two wordings as the English "people|men". The default is plural, "las personas", so the verb ("odien") is the same with either wording and nothing else in the sentence has to change. The same in 6:26.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:el nombre de ustedes|vuestro nombre}}
decisions.reason: With ustedes, "su nombre" could be read as the persecutors' name, so the span spells out "de ustedes".

decisions.choice: les {{gender:gens|hommes}} for the plural of the word for human beings, in this sermon (6:22, 6:26, 6:31)
decisions.reason: The word means people in general. "Les gens" is the natural inclusive French for people at large; "les humains" would sound as if humanity were set against something else. The traditional "les hommes" is the alternative, as in English. The Greek subjunctive after "when" looks ahead, which French says with the future after "quand" (L, B).

decisions.choice: watu, with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Watu" already means people, men and women; "wanaume" would mean males only, so Swahili has no gender span here or in 6:26, 6:31 and 6:45-49.

decisions.choice: "người ta" with no gender span (whole chapter)
decisions.reason: "người ta" (people) already includes men and women; the English traditional alternative "men" has no Vietnamese counterpart that would mean anything different. The same holds for "người" in 6:26, 6:31 and 6:45-49.

decisions.choice: "xua đuổi các con khỏi cộng đồng của họ" (B); "đuổi các con đi" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says shut out from the community; Balanced names the community so that the word does not read as a simple dismissal.

decisions.choice: "사람들" with no gender span, through this speech (6:22, 6:26, 6:31) and at 7:31
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: Korean "사람들" already means men and women and has no traditional masculine form here, so the setting has nothing to change, as in Mark 2:27 in Korean.

decisions.choice: "너희는 복이 있다" at the end of the sentence (L, B)
decisions.reason: Korean puts the "when" clauses before the main clause; the order changes but nothing is added.

source.text: χάρητε ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ καὶ σκιρτήσατε, ἰδοὺ γὰρ ὁ μισθὸς ὑμῶν πολὺς ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ· κατὰ τὰ αὐτὰ γὰρ ἐποίουν τοῖς προφήταις οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Rejoice in that the day and leap, look for the reward of you [is] great in the heaven; according to the same things for were doing to the prophets the fathers of them.

en.L: Rejoice in that day and leap [for joy], for look, your reward [is] great in heaven; for their fathers were doing the same things to the prophets.
en.B: Be glad when that day comes, and jump for joy, because a great reward is waiting for you in heaven. Their ancestors did the very same things to the prophets.
en.R: When that happens, be happy and jump for joy! God has a great reward for you in heaven. Long ago, their ancestors treated God's prophets in the same way.

es.L: {{plural_you:Alégrense|Alegraos}} en aquel día y {{plural_you:salten|saltad}} [de gozo], porque, {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} recompensa [es] grande en el cielo; pues lo mismo hacían a los profetas los padres de ellos.
es.B: {{plural_you:Alégrense|Alegraos}} cuando llegue ese día, y {{plural_you:salten|saltad}} de alegría, porque {{plural_you:les|os}} espera una gran recompensa en el cielo. Lo mismo hicieron con los profetas los antepasados de esa gente.
es.R: Cuando eso pase, ¡{{plural_you:alégrense|alegraos}} y {{plural_you:salten|saltad}} de alegría! Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} tiene una gran recompensa en el cielo. Hace mucho tiempo, los antepasados de esa gente trataron de la misma manera a los profetas de Dios.

fr.L: Réjouissez-vous en ce jour-là et bondissez [de joie], car voici, votre récompense [est] grande dans le ciel ; car c’est de la même manière que leurs pères agissaient envers les prophètes.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, réjouissez-vous et sautez de joie, car une grande récompense vous attend dans le ciel. C’est ainsi que leurs ancêtres ont traité les prophètes.
fr.R: Quand cela arrivera, soyez contents et sautez de joie ! Dieu vous réserve une grande récompense dans le ciel. Autrefois, leurs ancêtres ont traité les prophètes de Dieu de la même façon.

sw.L: Furahini siku hiyo na rukeni [kwa shangwe], kwa maana tazama, ujira wenu [ni] mkubwa mbinguni; kwa maana baba zao walikuwa wakiwatendea manabii mambo yale yale.
sw.B: Furahini siku hiyo itakapofika, mrukeruke kwa shangwe, kwa sababu ujira mkubwa unawangoja mbinguni. Mababu zao waliwatendea manabii mambo hayo hayo.
sw.R: Mambo hayo yatakapotokea, furahini na mrukeruke kwa shangwe! Mungu amewawekea ujira mkubwa mbinguni. Zamani mababu zao waliwatendea manabii wa Mungu vivyo hivyo.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy hãy vui mừng và nhảy [mừng], vì này, phần thưởng của các con trên trời thật lớn; vì tổ phụ của họ cũng đã làm y như vậy cho các nhà tiên tri.
vi.B: Khi ngày ấy đến, hãy vui mừng và nhảy múa, vì phần thưởng lớn đang dành cho các con trên trời. Tổ tiên của họ cũng đã đối xử với các nhà tiên tri y như vậy.
vi.R: Khi điều đó xảy ra, hãy vui mừng và nhảy múa! Đức Chúa Trời dành cho các con một phần thưởng lớn trên trời. Ngày xưa, tổ tiên của họ cũng đã đối xử với các nhà tiên tri của Đức Chúa Trời như vậy.

ko.L: 그날에 기뻐하고 뛰놀아라. 보라, 하늘에서 너희의 상이 크기 때문이다. 그들의 조상들이 예언자들에게 이와 똑같이 하였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그날이 오면 기뻐하고 기뻐 뛰어라. 하늘에서 큰 상이 너희를 기다리고 있다. 그들의 조상들도 예언자들에게 바로 그렇게 하였다.
ko.R: 그런 일이 생기면 기뻐하고 기뻐서 뛰어라! 하나님께서 하늘에서 너희에게 큰 상을 주실 것이다. 옛날에 그들의 조상들도 하나님의 예언자들에게 그렇게 하였다.

decisions.choice: your reward is great in heaven: God will reward you
decisions.reason: "In heaven" means with God, who keeps the reward for them. The reward is God's free gift, as 6:35 shows.

decisions.choice: their fathers: the ancestors of those who persecute
decisions.reason: Israel's prophets were often rejected and harmed (Jeremiah 20:1-2; 2 Chronicles 24:20-21; 11:47-51). Those who persecute Jesus's followers stand in that line.

decisions.choice: leap: jump for joy
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of John leaping in Elizabeth's womb (1:41, 44).

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence, as in Matthew 1:20.

decisions.choice: God has a great reward for you
decisions.reason: Readable names God, who gives the reward.

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: The word means forefathers, not only fathers; "ancestors" says so, as at 1:55.

decisions.choice: los padres de ellos (L); los antepasados de esa gente (B, R)
decisions.reason: They are the ancestors of the persecutors (meaning decision m2). Next to the ustedes forms, "sus" could be read as "your", so every level names whose ancestors they were. The same in 6:26.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:miren|mirad}} (L); not rendered (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term used across the New Testament drafts: the Greek "look" is kept at Literal and, said to a group, takes the plural_you setting; Balanced and Readable leave it out, as the English does.

decisions.choice: ujira
decisions.reason: The term used across the New Testament drafts for the Greek word for wages or reward (meaning decision m1): "ujira" is what is due for work done, and keeps one word for this Greek word everywhere.

decisions.choice: "tổ phụ" (L); "tổ tiên" (B, R) for "their fathers"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the ancestors of those who persecute; Literal keeps the older Bible word, Balanced and Readable the everyday one.

decisions.choice: "보라" (L), not rendered (B, R); "상" for misthos
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the pointer word as "보라", as through the Korean Matthew and Luke. "상" is the plain word for a reward given by God; "삯" would be wages.

source.text: πλὴν οὐαὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς πλουσίοις, ὅτι ἀπέχετε τὴν παράκλησιν ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: But woe to you the rich, for you are receiving in full the comfort of you.

en.L: But woe to you who are rich, for you are receiving your comfort in full.
en.B: But how terrible for you who are rich, because you already have your comfort in full.
en.R: But how terrible for you who are rich! You have already received all the comfort you are going to get.

es.L: Pero ¡ay de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los ricos!, porque ya {{plural_you:reciben|recibís}} por completo {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} consuelo.
es.B: Pero ¡ay de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los ricos!, porque ya {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} todo {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} consuelo.
es.R: Pero ¡qué terrible será para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los ricos! Ya {{plural_you:han recibido|habéis recibido}} todo el consuelo que {{plural_you:van|vais}} a recibir.

fr.L: Mais malheur à vous, les riches, car vous recevez pleinement votre consolation.
fr.B: Mais malheur à vous, les riches : vous avez déjà toute votre consolation.
fr.R: Mais quel malheur pour vous qui êtes riches ! Vous avez déjà reçu tout le réconfort que vous allez recevoir.

sw.L: Lakini ole wenu ninyi matajiri, kwa sababu mnapokea faraja yenu kikamilifu.
sw.B: Lakini ole wenu ninyi mlio matajiri, kwa sababu mmekwisha kupata faraja yenu yote.
sw.R: Lakini itakuwa vibaya sana kwenu ninyi mlio matajiri! Mmekwisha kupata faraja yote mtakayopata.

vi.L: Nhưng khốn cho các người là kẻ giàu, vì các người đã nhận đủ sự an ủi của mình rồi.
vi.B: Nhưng khốn cho các người là những kẻ giàu có, vì các người đã được an ủi đầy đủ rồi.
vi.R: Nhưng thật khốn khổ cho các người là những kẻ giàu có! Các người đã nhận tất cả sự an ủi mà các người sẽ có.

ko.L: 그러나 너희 부자들에게는 화가 있다! 너희가 너희의 위로를 이미 다 받고 있기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러나 너희 부자들은 얼마나 불행하냐! 너희는 받을 위로를 이미 다 받았다.
ko.R: 그러나 부자인 너희는 얼마나 불행하냐! 너희는 받을 위로를 이미 다 받았다. 더 받을 것이 없다.

decisions.choice: woe: a cry of grief and warning over people facing God's judgment
decisions.reason: The prophets used the cry (Isaiah 5:8-22; Amos 6:1). Each woe answers one of the blessings: the rich against the poor, the full against the hungry, the laughing against the weeping.

decisions.choice: you are receiving in full: you have had all you will get
alternatives: you are receiving some comfort now
decisions.reason: The verb was used on receipts: paid in full. Nothing more is owed.

decisions.choice: comfort: consolation
decisions.reason: The word is the one used of Israel's consolation in 2:25. Their wealth was all the comfort they looked for (compare 16:25).

decisions.choice: Woe to you (L); How terrible for you (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Woe" is rarely heard in everyday speech. Literal keeps the old cry; Balanced and Readable say what it means. All four woes (6:24-26) are worded the same way.

decisions.choice: ¡ay de ustedes! (L, B); ¡qué terrible será para ustedes! (R)
decisions.reason: The term used across the New Testament drafts: "¡ay!" is the Spanish cry of grief and warning (meaning decision m1) and reads naturally at Balanced too, where the English needs "How terrible"; Readable explains it, as the English Readable does. The same through 6:26.

decisions.choice: malheur à vous (L, B); quel malheur pour vous (R), for all four woes (6:24-26)
alternatives: c’est terrible pour vous (B, R), as the English Balanced
decisions.reason: The term sheet's form: French "malheur à vous" is still understood as a cry of grief and warning (m1), so Balanced keeps it where the English says "How terrible for you". Readable makes it a plain exclamation, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: ole wenu (L, B); itakuwa vibaya sana kwenu (R)
decisions.reason: The term used across the New Testament drafts: "ole" is the Swahili cry of grief and warning (meaning decision m1) and reads naturally at Balanced too, where the English needs "How terrible"; Readable explains it, as the English Readable does. The same through 6:26.

decisions.choice: "khốn cho" (L, B); "thật khốn khổ cho" (R) for "woe" (6:24-26)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 13:17 and 14:21 and the woes of Matthew (11:21; 23:13-29) and Luke 10:13 and 11:42-52: "khốn cho" is the Bible's cry of grief and warning; Readable uses the plainer "khốn khổ".

decisions.choice: "các người" for the rich and the others addressed in the woes
decisions.reason: The woes speak to people outside the circle of disciples, set against those Jesus calls "các con" in 6:20-23; the style guide gives "các người" for crowds and opponents.

decisions.choice: "화가 있다" (L); "얼마나 불행하냐" (B, R) for ouai, through 6:26
decisions.reason: Woe is a cry of grief and warning (meaning decision). As in Mark 13:17 and 14:21 in Korean, Literal keeps the traditional "화가 있다" in a modern ending, and Balanced and Readable say it with "불행하다".

source.text: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν, οἱ ἐμπεπλησμένοι νῦν, ὅτι πεινάσετε.

records.literal_gloss: Woe to you, the having been filled now, for you will hunger.

en.L: Woe to you, the ones filled now, for you will hunger.
en.B: How terrible for you who have eaten your fill now, because you will know hunger.
en.R: How terrible for you who have more than enough to eat now! You will be hungry later.

es.L: ¡Ay de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que ahora {{plural_you:están|estáis}} saciados!, porque {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} hambre.
es.B: ¡Ay de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que ahora {{plural_you:están|estáis}} hartos!, porque {{plural_you:pasarán|pasaréis}} hambre.
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que ahora {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} comida de sobra! Más tarde {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} hambre.

fr.L: Malheur à vous qui êtes rassasiés maintenant, car vous aurez faim.
fr.B: Malheur à vous qui avez maintenant tout ce qu’il vous faut à manger, car vous connaîtrez la faim.
fr.R: Quel malheur pour vous qui avez maintenant plus qu’assez à manger ! Plus tard, vous aurez faim.

sw.L: Ole wenu, ninyi mlioshiba sasa, kwa sababu mtaona njaa.
sw.B: Ole wenu ninyi mlioshiba sasa, kwa kuwa mtaijua njaa.
sw.R: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwenu ninyi mlio na chakula kingi kuliko mnachohitaji sasa! Baadaye mtakuwa na njaa.

vi.L: Khốn cho các người, là những kẻ bây giờ được no nê, vì các người sẽ đói.
vi.B: Khốn cho các người là những kẻ bây giờ đang được no đủ, vì các người sẽ phải đói.
vi.R: Thật khốn khổ cho các người là những kẻ bây giờ có dư thức ăn! Sau này các người sẽ bị đói.

ko.L: 지금 배부른 너희에게는 화가 있다! 너희가 굶주릴 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 지금 배부른 너희는 얼마나 불행하냐! 너희가 굶주리게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 지금 먹을 것이 넘치는 너희는 얼마나 불행하냐! 나중에 너희는 배고프게 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: who are full: who have eaten all they want
decisions.reason: The verb form describes a lasting state of being well fed. It answers the blessing on the hungry (6:21).

decisions.choice: the full will be hungry: God's reversal
decisions.reason: Mary sang that God sends the rich away empty (1:53).

decisions.choice: Woe to you (L); How terrible for you (B, R)
decisions.reason: The same wording for all four woes (see 6:24).

source.text: οὐαί, οἱ γελῶντες νῦν, ὅτι πενθήσετε καὶ κλαύσετε.

records.literal_gloss: Woe, the laughing now, for you will mourn and weep.

en.L: Woe, the ones laughing now, for you will mourn and weep.
en.B: How terrible for you who are laughing now, because you will grieve and cry.
en.R: How terrible for you who are laughing now! You will be sad, and you will cry.

es.L: ¡Ay, los que ahora {{plural_you:ríen|reís}}!, porque {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} duelo y {{plural_you:llorarán|lloraréis}}.
es.B: ¡Ay de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que ahora {{plural_you:ríen|reís}}!, porque {{plural_you:estarán|estaréis}} de luto y {{plural_you:llorarán|lloraréis}}.
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que ahora {{plural_you:ríen|reís}}! {{plural_you:Estarán|Estaréis}} tristes y {{plural_you:llorarán|lloraréis}}.

fr.L: Malheur, vous qui riez maintenant, car vous serez dans le deuil et vous pleurerez.
fr.B: Malheur à vous qui riez maintenant, car vous serez dans le deuil et dans les larmes.
fr.R: Quel malheur pour vous qui riez maintenant ! Vous serez tristes, et vous pleurerez.

sw.L: Ole, ninyi mnaocheka sasa, kwa sababu mtaomboleza na kulia.
sw.B: Ole wenu ninyi mnaocheka sasa, kwa kuwa mtaomboleza na kulia.
sw.R: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwenu ninyi mnaocheka sasa! Mtahuzunika, na mtalia.

vi.L: Khốn [cho] những kẻ bây giờ đang cười, vì các người sẽ buồn rầu và khóc lóc.
vi.B: Khốn cho các người là những kẻ bây giờ đang cười đùa, vì các người sẽ than khóc.
vi.R: Thật khốn khổ cho các người là những kẻ bây giờ đang cười! Các người sẽ buồn rầu và khóc lóc.

ko.L: 화가 있다, 지금 웃는 사람들아! 너희가 슬퍼하며 울 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 지금 웃는 너희는 얼마나 불행하냐! 너희가 슬퍼하며 울게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 지금 웃는 너희는 얼마나 불행하냐! 너희는 슬퍼하고 울게 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: woe, with no "to you": the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: woe to you, the reading of many manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add "to you" as in the first woe of the verse. The people spoken to are the same either way. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: mourn: grieve, as for the dead
decisions.reason: The laughter of the comfortable will turn to grief when God judges.

decisions.choice: Woe, the ones laughing (L); How terrible for you (B, R)
decisions.reason: The same wording for all four woes (see 6:24). Literal has no "to you", as the Greek has none.

decisions.choice: "Khốn [cho]" (L)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the SBLGNT has "woe" without "to you" here; Vietnamese needs "cho" after "khốn", so Literal brackets it and adds nothing more.

decisions.choice: "화가 있다, 지금 웃는 사람들아!" (L)
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT has "woe" with no "to you" (meaning decision); Literal keeps the bare cry with the address after it, as the English Literal does.

source.text: Οὐαὶ ὅταν καλῶς ὑμᾶς εἴπωσιν πάντες οἱ ἄνθρωποι, κατὰ τὰ αὐτὰ γὰρ ἐποίουν τοῖς ψευδοπροφήταις οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Woe when well of you speak all the men, according to the same things for were doing to the false prophets the fathers of them.

en.L: Woe when all {{gender:people|men}} speak well of you, for their fathers were doing the same things to the false prophets.
en.B: How terrible for you when all {{gender:people|men}} praise you! Their ancestors did just the same for the false prophets.
en.R: How terrible for you when everyone says good things about you! Long ago, their ancestors spoke well of the false prophets in the same way.

es.L: ¡Ay cuando {{gender:todas las personas|todos los hombres}} hablen bien de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}!, porque lo mismo hacían con los falsos profetas los padres de ellos.
es.B: ¡Ay de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} cuando {{gender:todas las personas|todos los hombres}} {{plural_you:los|os}} alaben! Lo mismo hicieron con los falsos profetas los antepasados de esa gente.
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} cuando todo el mundo hable bien de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}! Hace mucho tiempo, los antepasados de esa gente hablaban bien de los falsos profetas de la misma manera.

fr.L: Malheur, quand tous les {{gender:gens|hommes}} disent du bien de vous, car c’est de la même manière que leurs pères agissaient envers les faux prophètes.
fr.B: Malheur à vous quand tous les {{gender:gens|hommes}} font votre éloge ! C’est ainsi que leurs ancêtres ont traité les faux prophètes.
fr.R: Quel malheur pour vous quand tout le monde dit du bien de vous ! Autrefois, leurs ancêtres ont dit du bien des faux prophètes de la même façon.

sw.L: Ole, wakati watu wote watakapowasema vema, kwa maana baba zao walikuwa wakiwatendea manabii wa uongo mambo yale yale.
sw.B: Ole wenu watu wote wanapowasifu! Mababu zao waliwatendea manabii wa uongo vivyo hivyo.
sw.R: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwenu kila mtu anaposema mambo mazuri juu yenu! Zamani mababu zao waliwasifu manabii wa uongo vivyo hivyo.

vi.L: Khốn [cho các người] khi mọi người đều nói tốt về các người, vì tổ phụ của họ cũng đã làm y như vậy cho các tiên tri giả.
vi.B: Khốn cho các người khi mọi người đều khen ngợi các người! Tổ tiên của họ cũng đã khen các tiên tri giả y như vậy.
vi.R: Thật khốn khổ cho các người khi ai ai cũng nói tốt về các người! Ngày xưa, tổ tiên của họ cũng đã nói tốt về các tiên tri giả như vậy.

ko.L: 모든 사람이 너희를 좋게 말할 때에 화가 있다! 그들의 조상들이 거짓 예언자들에게 이와 똑같이 하였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 모든 사람이 너희를 칭찬할 때, 너희는 얼마나 불행하냐! 그들의 조상들도 거짓 예언자들에게 바로 그렇게 하였다.
ko.R: 모든 사람이 너희를 좋게 말할 때, 너희는 얼마나 불행하냐! 옛날에 그들의 조상들도 거짓 예언자들을 그렇게 좋게 말하였다.

decisions.choice: woe, with no "to you": the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: woe to you, the reading of many manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add "to you". The verb that follows is spoken to "you" in either reading. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: false prophets: people who claimed to speak for God but told people what they wanted to hear
decisions.reason: Jeremiah spoke of prophets who said "peace" when there was no peace, and the people loved it (Jeremiah 5:31; 6:14; 1 Kings 22:6-13).

decisions.choice: their fathers: the ancestors of those who now give praise
decisions.reason: As in 6:23, the ancestors of the speakers. Being praised by everyone may mean saying only what pleases.

decisions.choice: How terrible for you
decisions.reason: The same wording for all four woes (see 6:24); "you" is clear from the verb that follows.

decisions.choice: says good things about you (R); praise you (B)
decisions.reason: Plain words for the same thing.

decisions.choice: "tiên tri giả" for false prophets
decisions.reason: The word used in Matthew 7:15; Readable keeps it too, since the sentence itself sets them against the true prophets of 6:23.

source.text: Ἀλλὰ ὑμῖν λέγω τοῖς ἀκούουσιν, ἀγαπᾶτε τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ὑμῶν, καλῶς ποιεῖτε τοῖς μισοῦσιν ὑμᾶς, εὐλογεῖτε τοὺς καταρωμένους ὑμᾶς, προσεύχεσθε περὶ τῶν ἐπηρεαζόντων ὑμᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: But to you I say, to those hearing, love the enemies of you, well do to those hating you, \v 28 bless those cursing you, pray concerning those mistreating you.

en.L: But I say to you, the ones hearing: love your enemies; treat well those hating you; \v 28 bless those cursing you; pray for those mistreating you.
en.B: But to you who are listening I say this: love your enemies. Treat those who hate you well. \v 28 Speak blessings on those who curse you, and pray for those who treat you badly.
en.R: But I am telling you who are listening to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}: Love your enemies. Be good to people who hate you. \v 28 Ask God to bless people who curse you. Pray for people who are cruel to you.

es.L: Pero a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo: {{plural_you:amen|amad}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos; {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} bien a los que {{plural_you:los|os}} odian; \v 28 {{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} a los que {{plural_you:los|os}} maldicen; {{plural_you:oren|orad}} por los que {{plural_you:los|os}} maltratan.
es.B: Pero a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo esto: {{plural_you:amen|amad}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos. {{plural_you:Traten|Tratad}} bien a los que {{plural_you:los|os}} odian. \v 28 {{plural_you:Pronuncien|Pronunciad}} bendiciones sobre los que {{plural_you:los|os}} maldicen, y {{plural_you:oren|orad}} por los que {{plural_you:los|os}} tratan mal.
es.R: Pero a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo: {{plural_you:amen|amad}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos. {{plural_you:Sean|Sed}} buenos con la gente que {{plural_you:los|os}} odia. \v 28 {{plural_you:Pídanle|Pedidle}} a Dios que bendiga a quienes {{plural_you:los|os}} maldicen. {{plural_you:Oren|Orad}} por quienes {{plural_you:los|os}} tratan con crueldad.

fr.L: Mais à vous qui entendez, je dis : aimez vos ennemis ; traitez bien ceux qui vous haïssent ; \v 28 bénissez ceux qui vous maudissent ; priez pour ceux qui vous outragent.
fr.B: Mais à vous qui écoutez, je dis ceci : aimez vos ennemis. Montrez-vous bons envers ceux qui vous détestent. \v 28 Prononcez des bénédictions sur ceux qui vous maudissent, et priez pour ceux qui vous traitent mal.
fr.R: Mais je vous le dis, à vous qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écoutez : aimez vos ennemis. Soyez bons avec ceux qui vous détestent. \v 28 Demandez à Dieu de bénir ceux qui vous maudissent. Priez pour ceux qui sont méchants avec vous.

sw.L: Lakini nawaambia ninyi mnaosikia: wapendeni maadui wenu; watendeeni mema wanaowachukia; \v 28 wabarikini wanaowalaani; waombeeni wanaowaonea.
sw.B: Lakini ninyi mnaosikiliza nawaambia hivi: wapendeni maadui wenu. Watendeeni mema wale wanaowachukia. \v 28 Watakieni baraka wale wanaowalaani, na waombeeni wale wanaowatendea vibaya.
sw.R: Lakini ninyi mnaonisikiliza, nawaambia hivi: wapendeni maadui wenu. Wafanyieni mema watu wanaowachukia. \v 28 Mwombeni Mungu awabariki watu wanaowalaani. Waombeeni watu wanaowatendea ukatili.

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con là những người đang nghe: hãy yêu kẻ thù của các con, hãy làm điều tốt cho những kẻ ghét các con, \v 28 hãy chúc phước cho những kẻ rủa sả các con, hãy cầu nguyện cho những kẻ ngược đãi các con.
vi.B: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con là những người đang lắng nghe: Hãy yêu kẻ thù mình. Hãy đối xử tốt với những người ghét mình. \v 28 Hãy chúc phước cho những người nguyền rủa mình, và cầu nguyện cho những người đối xử tệ với mình.
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con là những người đang nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: Hãy yêu thương kẻ thù của mình. Hãy làm điều tốt cho những người ghét mình. \v 28 Hãy xin Đức Chúa Trời ban phước cho những người nguyền rủa mình. Hãy cầu nguyện cho những người đối xử tàn nhẫn với mình.

ko.L: 그러나 듣고 있는 너희에게 내가 말한다. 너희 원수들을 사랑하여라. 너희를 미워하는 사람들에게 잘해 주어라. \v 28 너희를 저주하는 사람들을 축복하여라. 너희를 모욕하는 사람들을 위하여 기도하여라.
ko.B: 그러나 내 말을 듣고 있는 너희에게 말한다. 원수를 사랑하여라. 너희를 미워하는 사람들에게 선을 베풀어라. \v 28 너희를 저주하는 사람들에게 복을 빌어 주고, 너희를 학대하는 사람들을 위하여 기도하여라.
ko.R: 그러나 내 말을 듣고 있는 너희에게 말한다. 너희 원수들을 사랑하여라. 너희를 미워하는 사람들에게 잘해 주어라. \v 28 너희를 저주하는 사람들에게 하나님께서 복을 주시도록 빌어 주어라. 너희를 못살게 구는 사람들을 위하여 기도하여라.

decisions.choice: but to you who hear: Jesus turns from the woes to those listening
alternatives: a contrast with the law of Moses
decisions.reason: "But" marks the turn from the people under the woes to those who hear and will obey (6:47).

decisions.choice: love: active goodwill shown in deeds
decisions.reason: The commands that follow show what this love does: it treats well, blesses and prays. Leviticus 19:18 commanded love for one's neighbor; Jesus extends it to enemies.

decisions.choice: bless those who curse you: ask God's good for those who call down harm on you
decisions.reason: To curse was to call on God to bring harm; to bless was to call on him to give good (Romans 12:14).

decisions.choice: mistreat: insult, abuse, threaten
decisions.reason: The verb means to treat someone spitefully (1 Peter 3:16).

decisions.choice: speak blessings on
decisions.reason: Balanced makes clear that blessing is spoken, as cursing is.

decisions.choice: Ask God to bless
decisions.reason: Readable says what blessing someone means, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: "chúc phước" (L, B); "xin Đức Chúa Trời ban phước" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says asking God's good for them; "chúc phước" is the Protestant word, and Readable names God, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "kẻ thù mình", "những người ghét mình" with the reflexive "mình" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese commands repeat the possessive less than English; the reflexive "mình" refers back to those addressed, and keeps the four commands short.

decisions.choice: "축복하여라" (L); "복을 빌어 주어라" (B); "하나님께서 복을 주시도록 빌어 주어라" (R)
decisions.reason: To bless here is to ask God's good for someone (meaning decision); Balanced says that plainly, and Readable names God, as the English Readable does.

source.text: τῷ τύπτοντί σε ἐπὶ τὴν σιαγόνα πάρεχε καὶ τὴν ἄλλην, καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἴροντός σου τὸ ἱμάτιον καὶ τὸν χιτῶνα μὴ κωλύσῃς.

records.literal_gloss: To the one striking you on the cheek offer also the other, and from the one taking away of you the cloak also the tunic do not withhold.

en.L: To the one striking you on the cheek, hold out the other [one] also, and from the one taking away your cloak, do not keep back the tunic also.
en.B: If anyone strikes you on the cheek, present the other one as well. If anyone takes your coat, let {{gender:them|him}} have your shirt too.
en.R: If someone hits you on one side of your face, let {{gender:them|him}} hit the other side too. If someone takes your coat, do not stop {{gender:them|him}} from taking your shirt as well.

es.L: Al que te golpea en la mejilla, ofrécele también la otra; y al que te quita el manto, no le impidas [llevarse] también la túnica.
es.B: Si alguien te golpea en una mejilla, preséntale también la otra. Si alguien te quita el abrigo, déjale llevarse también la camisa.
es.R: Si alguien te pega en un lado de la cara, deja que te pegue también en el otro. Si alguien te quita el abrigo, no le impidas que se lleve también tu camisa.

fr.L: À celui qui te frappe sur la joue, présente aussi l’autre, et à celui qui t’enlève ton manteau, ne refuse pas non plus la tunique.
fr.B: Si quelqu’un te frappe sur la joue, tends-lui aussi l’autre. Si quelqu’un te prend ton manteau, abandonne-lui aussi ta chemise.
fr.R: Si quelqu’un te frappe sur une joue, laisse-le te frapper aussi sur l’autre. Si quelqu’un te prend ton manteau, laisse-le aussi prendre ta chemise.

sw.L: Yeye akupigaye shavuni, umgeuzie pia lile jingine; na yeye akunyang'anyaye vazi lako la nje, usimzuie kuchukua na vazi la ndani pia.
sw.B: Mtu akikupiga shavuni, mgeuzie na shavu lingine pia. Mtu akichukua koti lako, mwache achukue na shati lako pia.
sw.R: Mtu akikupiga kofi upande mmoja wa uso, mwache akupige na upande mwingine pia. Mtu akichukua koti lako, usimzuie kuchukua na shati lako.

vi.L: Ai vả má con, hãy đưa luôn má kia, và ai lấy áo ngoài của con, cũng đừng ngăn [người ấy lấy] áo trong.
vi.B: Nếu ai tát con má bên này, hãy đưa luôn má bên kia. Nếu ai lấy áo ngoài của con, hãy để người ấy lấy cả áo trong.
vi.R: Nếu ai đánh vào một bên má con, hãy để người ấy đánh luôn bên kia. Nếu ai lấy áo ngoài của con, đừng ngăn người ấy lấy luôn áo trong.

ko.L: 네 뺨을 치는 사람에게는 다른 [뺨]도 내밀어라. 그리고 네 겉옷을 빼앗아 가는 사람에게는 속옷도 거절하지 마라.
ko.B: 누가 네 뺨을 치거든 다른 뺨도 돌려 대어라. 누가 네 겉옷을 가져가거든 속옷까지 가져가게 두어라.
ko.R: 누가 네 한쪽 뺨을 때리면, 다른 쪽 뺨도 때리게 내밀어라. 누가 네 겉옷을 빼앗아 가면, 속옷까지 가져가도 막지 마라.

decisions.choice: striking on the cheek: an insult as much as an injury
decisions.reason: A slap on the face was a public insult (Lamentations 3:30; Isaiah 50:6). Jesus speaks of not striking back, not of failing to protect others.

decisions.choice: cloak and tunic: the outer garment and the inner one worn next to the skin
decisions.reason: In Luke the cloak is taken first, which suggests a robbery; Matthew 5:40 speaks of a lawsuit. The tunic was the last garment a person had (3:11).

decisions.choice: do not hold back: do not refuse
alternatives: do not take back by force
decisions.reason: The verb means to hinder or keep from.

decisions.choice: coat ... shirt
decisions.reason: The nearest everyday words for the outer and inner garments, as at 3:11.

decisions.choice: te, ofrécele, déjale: "tú", with no plural_you or gender span
decisions.reason: Here and in 6:30 Jesus speaks to each hearer as one person, so Spanish uses "tú", which has no setting. The English offers "them" with "him" as the traditional form; Spanish "le" serves for a man or a woman, so there is nothing for the gender setting to change.

decisions.choice: el manto, la túnica (L); el abrigo, la camisa (B, R)
decisions.reason: The outer garment and the one worn next to the skin (meaning decision m2). Literal names the ancient garments; Balanced and Readable use the nearest modern ones, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "tu" for these sayings; "quelqu’un … lui, le" with no gender setting, for the whole sermon (6:29, 6:40, 6:47-49)
alternatives: vous, as in the surrounding verses
a gender span on the pronouns, as the English has
decisions.reason: The Greek turns to the singular in 6:29-30, so French says "tu", as the style guide asks. Where the English needs a gender span for a pronoun, French "quelqu’un", "celui qui" and the "lui", "le" and "il" that refer back to them already mean anyone, so no span is added (style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: vazi la nje, vazi la ndani (L); koti, shati (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 5:40: the outer garment and the one worn next to the skin (meaning decision m2). Literal describes the two garments; Balanced and Readable use the nearest modern ones, as the English does.

decisions.choice: umgeuzie, mwache, usimzuie, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English offers "them" with "him" as the traditional form. Swahili marks the person inside the verb (-m-), which serves for a man or a woman, so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: "con" (singular) for "you" in 6:29-30 and 6:41-42
decisions.reason: The Greek turns to the singular, speaking to each hearer; Vietnamese marks it with "con", the singular of the "các con" Jesus uses to his disciples.

decisions.choice: "áo ngoài" and "áo trong" for cloak and tunic
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the outer garment and the one worn next to the skin; Vietnamese names them by where they are worn, which a reader pictures at once. "người ấy" has no gender span.

decisions.choice: "겉옷" and "속옷" at every level; "네" (singular); no gender span
decisions.reason: The outer garment and the one worn next to the skin (meaning decision) are "겉옷" and "속옷" in Korean; the English "coat" and "shirt" have no better Korean match. Jesus turns to the singular "you" here, and Korean follows. "누가" and "사람" already include anyone, so the English gender span has nothing to change.

source.text: παντὶ αἰτοῦντί σε δίδου, καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἴροντος τὰ σὰ μὴ ἀπαίτει.

records.literal_gloss: To everyone asking you give, and from the one taking away the yours not ask back.

en.L: To everyone asking you, give; and from the one taking away what [is] yours, do not demand [it] back.
en.B: Keep giving to everyone who asks you for something, and if anyone takes what is yours, do not ask for it back.
en.R: Whenever someone asks you for something, give it. If someone takes things that belong to you, do not ask for them back.

es.L: A todo el que te pide, da; y al que te quita lo tuyo, no [se lo] reclames.
es.B: Da siempre a todo el que te pida algo, y si alguien te quita lo que es tuyo, no le pidas que te lo devuelva.
es.R: Cada vez que alguien te pida algo, dáselo. Si alguien se lleva cosas tuyas, no le pidas que te las devuelva.

fr.L: À quiconque te demande, donne ; et à celui qui t’enlève ce qui est à toi, ne [le] réclame pas.
fr.B: Donne toujours à quiconque te demande quelque chose, et si quelqu’un prend ce qui t’appartient, ne le lui réclame pas.
fr.R: Chaque fois que quelqu’un te demande quelque chose, donne-le-lui. Si quelqu’un te prend des choses qui sont à toi, ne les lui redemande pas.

sw.L: Kila akuombaye mpe, na yeye achukuaye vitu vyako usimdai [akurudishie].
sw.B: Endelea kumpa kila mtu anayekuomba kitu, na mtu akichukua kilicho chako, usimdai akurudishie.
sw.R: Mtu yeyote akikuomba kitu, mpe. Mtu akichukua vitu vyako, usimwambie avirudishe.

vi.L: Ai xin con, hãy cho; và ai lấy của con, đừng đòi lại.
vi.B: Ai xin gì, hãy cứ cho; và ai lấy đồ của con, đừng đòi lại.
vi.R: Khi có ai xin con điều gì, hãy cho người ấy. Nếu ai lấy đồ của con, đừng đòi lại.

ko.L: 너에게 구하는 모든 사람에게 주어라. 그리고 네 것을 빼앗아 가는 사람에게서 [그것을] 돌려 달라고 하지 마라.
ko.B: 너에게 무엇을 달라고 하는 사람에게는 누구에게나 계속 주어라. 누가 네 것을 가져가거든 돌려 달라고 하지 마라.
ko.R: 누가 너에게 무엇을 달라고 하면 주어라. 누가 네 물건을 가져가면 돌려 달라고 하지 마라.

decisions.choice: give ... do not demand back: present tense, what one does again and again
decisions.reason: The commands describe a way of living, not a single gift.

decisions.choice: demand back: reclaim what was taken
alternatives: ask for a loan to be repaid
decisions.reason: The verb means to ask back what is one's own.

decisions.choice: Keep giving
decisions.reason: Balanced shows the force of the present tense, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: "hãy cứ cho" (B)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says giving again and again; "cứ" says that in Vietnamese, as in Matthew 7:7.

source.text: καὶ καθὼς θέλετε ἵνα ποιῶσιν ὑμῖν οἱ ἄνθρωποι, ποιεῖτε αὐτοῖς ὁμοίως.

records.literal_gloss: And as you want that should do to you the men, do to them likewise.

en.L: And just as you want {{gender:people|men}} to do to you, do to them likewise.
en.B: However you want {{gender:people|men}} to treat you, treat them the same way.
en.R: Think about how you want others to treat you. Then treat them that way.

es.L: Y así como {{plural_you:quieren|queréis}} que {{gender:los demás|los hombres}} {{plural_you:les|os}} hagan, {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} también con ellos de la misma manera.
es.B: Como {{plural_you:quieran|queráis}} que {{gender:los demás|los hombres}} {{plural_you:los|os}} traten, {{plural_you:trátenlos|tratadlos}} así a ellos.
es.R: {{plural_you:Piensen|Pensad}} en cómo {{plural_you:quieren|queréis}} que los demás {{plural_you:los|os}} traten. Luego {{plural_you:trátenlos|tratadlos}} de esa manera.

fr.L: Et selon que vous voulez que les {{gender:gens|hommes}} agissent envers vous, agissez pareillement envers eux.
fr.B: La manière dont vous voulez que les {{gender:gens|hommes}} vous traitent, traitez-les de la même façon.
fr.R: Pensez à la manière dont vous voulez que les autres vous traitent. Puis traitez-les de cette manière.

sw.L: Na kama mnavyotaka watu wawatendee, watendeeni wao vivyo hivyo.
sw.B: Kama vile mnavyotaka watu wawatendee ninyi, nanyi watendeeni vivyo hivyo.
sw.R: Fikirini jinsi mnavyotaka watu wengine wawatendee. Kisha nanyi watendeeni hivyo.

vi.L: Và các con muốn người ta làm cho mình thế nào, thì hãy làm cho họ như vậy.
vi.B: Các con muốn người ta đối xử với mình thế nào, hãy đối xử với họ như thế.
vi.R: Hãy nghĩ xem các con muốn người khác đối xử với mình thế nào. Rồi hãy đối xử với họ như vậy.

ko.L: 그리고 사람들이 너희에게 해 주기를 너희가 원하는 대로, 너희도 그들에게 그렇게 해 주어라.
ko.B: 사람들이 너희에게 해 주기를 바라는 그대로 너희도 그들에게 해 주어라.
ko.R: 다른 사람들이 너희에게 어떻게 해 주기를 바라는지 생각해 보아라. 그리고 너희도 그들에게 그렇게 해 주어라.

decisions.choice: treat others as you want to be treated: a positive command
alternatives: only a warning not to harm
decisions.reason: Jewish teaching knew the saying in a negative form: do to no one what you hate (Tobit 4:15). Jesus states it as a command to act. Matthew 7:12 adds that this sums up the Law and the Prophets.

decisions.choice: two sentences: think, then treat
decisions.reason: Readable splits the saying into two short steps.

decisions.choice: {{gender:los demás|los hombres}}
decisions.reason: Here "ellos" refers back to the people, and after "las personas" it would have to change to "ellas". "Los demás" agrees with "ellos" in both wordings, so only the noun phrase changes.

source.text: Καὶ εἰ ἀγαπᾶτε τοὺς ἀγαπῶντας ὑμᾶς, ποία ὑμῖν χάρις ἐστίν;

records.literal_gloss: And if you love those loving you, what kind of to you credit is it?

en.L: And if you love those loving you, what kind of credit is [it] to you?
en.B: If you love those who love you, what thanks do you deserve?
en.R: If you love only the people who love you, should anyone thank you for that?

es.L: Y si {{plural_you:aman|amáis}} a los que {{plural_you:los|os}} aman, ¿qué clase de reconocimiento es [ese] para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?
es.B: Si {{plural_you:aman|amáis}} a quienes {{plural_you:los|os}} aman, ¿qué agradecimiento {{plural_you:merecen|merecéis}}?
es.R: Si {{plural_you:aman|amáis}} solo a los que {{plural_you:los|os}} aman, ¿por qué alguien tendría que {{plural_you:darles|daros}} las gracias?

fr.L: Et si vous aimez ceux qui vous aiment, quelle reconnaissance vous [en] revient ?
fr.B: Si vous aimez ceux qui vous aiment, quelle reconnaissance méritez-vous ?
fr.R: Si vous aimez seulement les gens qui vous aiment, est-ce qu’on doit vous dire merci pour cela ?

sw.L: Na kama mnawapenda wale wanaowapenda, ni shukrani ya namna gani kwenu?
sw.B: Mkiwapenda wale wanaowapenda, mnastahili shukrani gani?
sw.R: Mkiwapenda tu watu wanaowapenda, je, kuna mtu anayepaswa kuwashukuru kwa hilo?

vi.L: Và nếu các con yêu những người yêu các con, thì các con có ơn gì?
vi.B: Nếu các con yêu những người yêu mình, thì có gì đáng khen đâu?
vi.R: Nếu các con chỉ yêu những người yêu mình, thì có ai cảm ơn các con vì việc đó không?

ko.L: 그리고 너희를 사랑하는 사람들을 너희가 사랑한다면, 너희에게 무슨 칭찬할 것이 있느냐?
ko.B: 너희를 사랑하는 사람들을 사랑한다면, 그것이 너희에게 무슨 칭찬거리가 되겠느냐?
ko.R: 너희를 사랑하는 사람들만 사랑한다면, 누가 너희를 칭찬하겠느냐?

decisions.choice: credit: thanks, the favor earned by an act that deserves it
decisions.reason: The word usually translated "grace" here means credit or thanks. The question asks what is so special about such love. Matthew 5:46 has "what reward"; some read the thanks as God's favor (compare 6:35).

decisions.choice: what kind of: a question expecting the answer none
alternatives: a real question about how much credit
decisions.reason: The question says that such love deserves no special thanks.

decisions.choice: credit (L); thanks (B); thank you (R)
decisions.reason: The key term "grace" would mislead here, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: only
decisions.reason: Readable makes the contrast clear: love that goes only to those who love back.

decisions.choice: reconocimiento (L); agradecimiento (B); dar las gracias (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is the one usually rendered "gracia", but here it means the thanks or credit an act deserves (meaning decision m1), so the key term is not used. The same in 6:33 and 6:34.

decisions.choice: quelle reconnaissance (L, B); est-ce qu’on doit vous dire merci (R), in 6:32-34
decisions.reason: As in English, the key term "grâce" would mislead here (m1): the word means the thanks an act deserves. "Quel mérite" would bring in the idea of earning merit before God. "Reconnaissance" is the gratitude owed.

decisions.choice: shukrani (L, B); kuwashukuru (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is the one rendered "neema" elsewhere, but here it means the thanks or credit an act deserves (meaning decision m1), so the key term is not used. The same in 6:33 and 6:34.

decisions.choice: "có ơn gì" (L); "có gì đáng khen" (B); "có ai cảm ơn" (R) for "what credit" (also 6:33-34)
decisions.reason: The word is the one usually rendered grace; here it means the thanks or favor an act earns (meaning decision), so it is not the key term "ân điển". Literal keeps "ơn", Balanced and Readable say what is meant.

decisions.choice: "무슨 칭찬할 것이 있느냐" (L); "무슨 칭찬거리가 되겠느냐" (B); "누가 너희를 칭찬하겠느냐" (R), in 6:32-34
decisions.reason: The Greek word is the one for grace, but here it means the thanks or credit an act deserves (meaning decision); "은혜" would not be understood. The question expects the answer "none".

source.text: καὶ γὰρ οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ τοὺς ἀγαπῶντας αὐτοὺς ἀγαπῶσιν.

records.literal_gloss: Even for the sinners those loving them love.

en.L: For even the sinners love those loving them.
en.B: After all, sinners too love those who love them back.
en.R: Even sinful people love those who love them.

es.L: Porque también los pecadores aman a los que los aman.
es.B: Al fin y al cabo, también los pecadores aman a quienes los aman a ellos.
es.R: Hasta los pecadores aman a los que los aman.

fr.L: Car même les pécheurs aiment ceux qui les aiment.
fr.B: Après tout, les pécheurs aussi aiment ceux qui les aiment en retour.
fr.R: Même ceux qui désobéissent à Dieu aiment les gens qui les aiment.

sw.L: Kwa maana hata wenye dhambi huwapenda wale wanaowapenda.
sw.B: Hata wenye dhambi huwapenda wale wanaowapenda.
sw.R: Hata watu wenye dhambi huwapenda wale wanaowapenda.

vi.L: Vì ngay cả những kẻ tội lỗi cũng yêu những người yêu họ.
vi.B: Ngay cả người tội lỗi cũng yêu những người yêu lại mình.
vi.R: Ngay cả những người tội lỗi cũng yêu những người yêu họ.

ko.L: 죄인들도 자기들을 사랑하는 사람들을 사랑하기 때문이다.
ko.B: 죄인들도 자기를 사랑하는 사람들은 사랑한다.
ko.R: 죄를 짓고 사는 사람들도 자기를 사랑하는 사람들은 사랑한다.

decisions.choice: sinners: people known for not keeping God's law
decisions.reason: In the Gospels "sinners" are people who openly ignore God's law, often named with tax collectors (5:30). Matthew 5:46 has "tax collectors" here.

decisions.choice: sinful people
decisions.reason: Readable uses a plain phrase.

decisions.choice: les pécheurs (L, B); ceux qui désobéissent à Dieu (R), in 6:32-34
decisions.reason: "Les pécheurs" is the term sheet's word. The English Readable uses a plain phrase; French Readable does the same and says what made them sinners (m1).

decisions.choice: "죄인들" (L, B); "죄를 짓고 사는 사람들" (R), in 6:32-34
decisions.reason: Sinners here are people known for not keeping God's law (meaning decision); Readable describes them, as the English Readable says "sinful people".

source.text: καὶ ἐὰν ἀγαθοποιῆτε τοὺς ἀγαθοποιοῦντας ὑμᾶς, ποία ὑμῖν χάρις ἐστίν;

records.literal_gloss: And if you do good to those doing good to you, what kind of to you credit is it?

en.L: And if you do good to those doing good to you, what kind of credit is [it] to you?
en.B: And if you do good to those who do good to you, what thanks do you deserve?
en.R: If you do good things only for people who do good things for you, should anyone thank you for that?

es.L: Y si {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} el bien a los que {{plural_you:les|os}} hacen el bien, ¿qué clase de reconocimiento es [ese] para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?
es.B: Y si {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} el bien a quienes {{plural_you:les|os}} hacen el bien, ¿qué agradecimiento {{plural_you:merecen|merecéis}}?
es.R: Si {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} cosas buenas solo por los que {{plural_you:les|os}} hacen cosas buenas, ¿por qué alguien tendría que {{plural_you:darles|daros}} las gracias?

fr.L: Et si vous faites du bien à ceux qui vous font du bien, quelle reconnaissance vous [en] revient ?
fr.B: Et si vous faites du bien à ceux qui vous en font, quelle reconnaissance méritez-vous ?
fr.R: Si vous faites du bien seulement aux gens qui vous font du bien, est-ce qu’on doit vous dire merci pour cela ?

sw.L: Na kama mnawatendea mema wale wanaowatendea mema, ni shukrani ya namna gani kwenu?
sw.B: Na mkiwatendea mema wale wanaowatendea mema, mnastahili shukrani gani?
sw.R: Mkiwatendea mambo mazuri wale tu wanaowatendea mambo mazuri, je, kuna mtu anayepaswa kuwashukuru kwa hilo?

vi.L: Và nếu các con làm điều tốt cho những người làm điều tốt cho các con, thì các con có ơn gì?
vi.B: Nếu các con làm ơn cho những người làm ơn cho mình, thì có gì đáng khen đâu?
vi.R: Nếu các con chỉ làm điều tốt cho những người làm điều tốt cho mình, thì có ai cảm ơn các con vì việc đó không?

ko.L: 그리고 너희에게 선을 행하는 사람들에게 너희가 선을 행한다면, 너희에게 무슨 칭찬할 것이 있느냐?
ko.B: 너희에게 잘해 주는 사람들에게 잘해 준다면, 그것이 너희에게 무슨 칭찬거리가 되겠느냐?
ko.R: 너희에게 잘해 주는 사람들에게만 잘해 준다면, 누가 너희를 칭찬하겠느냐?

decisions.choice: credit: thanks, the favor earned by an act that deserves it
decisions.reason: As in 6:32, the word usually translated "grace" means credit or thanks.

decisions.choice: credit (L); thanks (B); thank you (R)
decisions.reason: As in 6:32.

source.text: καὶ οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ποιοῦσιν.

records.literal_gloss: Even the sinners the same do.

en.L: Even the sinners do the same.
en.B: Even sinners do as much.
en.R: Sinful people do that too.

es.L: También los pecadores hacen lo mismo.
es.B: Hasta los pecadores hacen otro tanto.
es.R: Los pecadores también hacen eso.

fr.L: Même les pécheurs font la même chose.
fr.B: Les pécheurs en font autant.
fr.R: Ceux qui désobéissent à Dieu le font aussi.

sw.L: Hata wenye dhambi hufanya vivyo hivyo.
sw.B: Hata wenye dhambi hufanya hivyo.
sw.R: Watu wenye dhambi nao hufanya hivyo.

vi.L: Ngay cả những kẻ tội lỗi cũng làm như vậy.
vi.B: Ngay cả người tội lỗi cũng làm được như thế.
vi.R: Những người tội lỗi cũng làm như vậy.

ko.L: 죄인들도 똑같이 한다.
ko.B: 죄인들도 그만큼은 한다.
ko.R: 죄를 짓고 사는 사람들도 그렇게 한다.

decisions.choice: even: the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: for even, the reading of many manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add "for", as in 6:32. The sense is the same. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

source.text: καὶ ἐὰν δανίσητε παρ’ ὧν ἐλπίζετε λαβεῖν, ποία ὑμῖν χάρις ἐστίν;

records.literal_gloss: And if you lend [to those] from whom you hope to receive, what kind of to you credit is it?

en.L: And if you lend [to those] from whom you hope to receive [back], what kind of credit is [it] to you?
en.B: And if you lend to people you expect to pay you back, what thanks do you deserve?
en.R: If you lend money only to people who you think will pay you back, should anyone thank you for that?

es.L: Y si {{plural_you:prestan|prestáis}} [a aquellos] de quienes {{plural_you:esperan|esperáis}} recibir [de vuelta], ¿qué clase de reconocimiento es [ese] para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?
es.B: Y si {{plural_you:prestan|prestáis}} a quienes {{plural_you:esperan|esperáis}} que {{plural_you:les|os}} paguen, ¿qué agradecimiento {{plural_you:merecen|merecéis}}?
es.R: Si {{plural_you:prestan|prestáis}} dinero solo a los que {{plural_you:creen|creéis}} que {{plural_you:les|os}} van a pagar, ¿por qué alguien tendría que {{plural_you:darles|daros}} las gracias?

fr.L: Et si vous prêtez [à ceux] de qui vous espérez recevoir [en retour], quelle reconnaissance vous [en] revient ?
fr.B: Et si vous prêtez à ceux dont vous attendez d’être remboursés, quelle reconnaissance méritez-vous ?
fr.R: Si vous prêtez de l’argent seulement à ceux qui, pensez-vous, vous rembourseront, est-ce qu’on doit vous dire merci pour cela ?

sw.L: Na kama mnawakopesha wale ambao mnatumaini kupokea [kitu] kutoka kwao, ni shukrani ya namna gani kwenu?
sw.B: Na mkiwakopesha watu mnaotarajia watawalipa, mnastahili shukrani gani?
sw.R: Mkiwakopesha pesa wale tu mnaodhani watawalipa, je, kuna mtu anayepaswa kuwashukuru kwa hilo?

vi.L: Và nếu các con cho vay [những người] mà các con mong được nhận lại, thì các con có ơn gì?
vi.B: Nếu các con cho những người mình mong sẽ trả lại vay mượn, thì có gì đáng khen đâu?
vi.R: Nếu các con chỉ cho vay tiền những người mình nghĩ sẽ trả lại, thì có ai cảm ơn các con vì việc đó không?

ko.L: 그리고 [돌려] 받기를 바라는 사람들에게 너희가 꾸어 준다면, 너희에게 무슨 칭찬할 것이 있느냐?
ko.B: 돌려받을 것을 기대하고 꾸어 준다면, 그것이 너희에게 무슨 칭찬거리가 되겠느냐?
ko.R: 갚을 것 같은 사람들에게만 돈을 꾸어 준다면, 누가 너희를 칭찬하겠느냐?

decisions.choice: credit: thanks, the favor earned by an act that deserves it
decisions.reason: As in 6:32, the word usually translated "grace" means credit or thanks.

decisions.choice: lend: lending to a neighbor in need
decisions.reason: The law told Israel to lend freely to a poor neighbor and not to charge interest (Deuteronomy 15:7-8; Leviticus 25:35-37).

decisions.choice: credit (L); thanks (B); thank you (R)
decisions.reason: As in 6:32.

decisions.choice: money
decisions.reason: Readable says what is lent.

source.text: καὶ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἁμαρτωλοῖς δανίζουσιν ἵνα ἀπολάβωσιν τὰ ἴσα.

records.literal_gloss: Even sinners to sinners lend so that they might receive back the equal [things].

en.L: Even sinners lend to sinners so that they may receive back the same [amount].
en.B: Sinners also lend to sinners, so as to get back as much again.
en.R: Even sinful people lend to other sinful people, so that they will get back the same amount.

es.L: También los pecadores prestan a los pecadores para recibir de vuelta otro tanto.
es.B: También los pecadores prestan a otros pecadores para que se les devuelva otro tanto.
es.R: Hasta los pecadores les prestan a otros pecadores para que les devuelvan la misma cantidad.

fr.L: Même des pécheurs prêtent à des pécheurs afin de recevoir en retour autant.
fr.B: Les pécheurs aussi prêtent aux pécheurs, pour qu’on leur rende autant.
fr.R: Même ceux qui désobéissent à Dieu prêtent à d’autres comme eux, pour qu’on leur rende la même somme.

sw.L: Hata wenye dhambi huwakopesha wenye dhambi ili warudishiwe kiasi kile kile.
sw.B: Hata wenye dhambi huwakopesha wenye dhambi wenzao ili walipwe kiasi kile kile.
sw.R: Hata watu wenye dhambi huwakopesha wenye dhambi wengine ili warudishiwe kiasi kile kile.

vi.L: Ngay cả những kẻ tội lỗi cũng cho những kẻ tội lỗi vay, để nhận lại bằng số ấy.
vi.B: Người tội lỗi cũng cho người tội lỗi vay, để được trả lại đủ số.
vi.R: Ngay cả những người tội lỗi cũng cho những người tội lỗi khác vay, để được trả lại đúng số tiền đã cho vay.

ko.L: 죄인들도 같은 만큼 돌려받으려고 죄인들에게 꾸어 준다.
ko.B: 죄인들도 꾸어 준 만큼 돌려받으려고 죄인들에게 꾸어 준다.
ko.R: 죄를 짓고 사는 사람들도 꾸어 준 만큼 다시 받으려고 서로 돈을 꾸어 준다.

decisions.choice: the same: the same amount as was lent
alternatives: a like favor in return, a loan when they need one
decisions.reason: The words mean "the equal things". Either way, the lender looks for a return.

source.text: πλὴν ἀγαπᾶτε τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ὑμῶν καὶ ἀγαθοποιεῖτε καὶ δανίζετε μηδὲν ἀπελπίζοντες· καὶ ἔσται ὁ μισθὸς ὑμῶν πολύς, καὶ ἔσεσθε υἱοὶ Ὑψίστου, ὅτι αὐτὸς χρηστός ἐστιν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀχαρίστους καὶ πονηρούς.

records.literal_gloss: But love the enemies of you and do good and lend nothing expecting in return; and will be the reward of you great, and you will be sons of [the] Most High, for he kind is to the ungrateful and evil.

en.L: Rather, love your enemies and do good and lend, hoping for nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be {{gender:children|sons}} of [the] Most High, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is kind toward the ungrateful and evil [ones].
en.B: Instead, love your enemies, treat them well, and lend without hoping to get anything back. Then you will receive a great reward, and you will be {{gender:children|sons}} of the Most High, since {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is good to the thankless and the wicked.
en.R: Instead, love your enemies. Do good to them. Lend to them, and do not expect to get anything back. Then you will have a great reward, and you will be {{gender:children|sons}} of God Most High. For God is kind to people who never thank {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and to people who are evil.

es.L: Al contrario, {{plural_you:amen|amad}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos, y {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} el bien, y {{plural_you:presten|prestad}} sin esperar nada a cambio; y {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} recompensa será grande, y {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} hijos del Altísimo, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es bondadoso con los ingratos y malvados.
es.B: Más bien, {{plural_you:amen|amad}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos, {{plural_you:trátenlos|tratadlos}} bien y {{plural_you:presten|prestad}} sin esperar nada a cambio. Así {{plural_you:recibirán|recibiréis}} una gran recompensa y {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} hijos del Altísimo, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es bueno con los desagradecidos y con los malvados.
es.R: Al contrario, {{plural_you:amen|amad}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos. {{plural_you:Háganles|Hacedles}} el bien. {{plural_you:Préstenles|Prestadles}}, y no {{plural_you:esperen|esperéis}} recibir nada a cambio. Entonces {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} una gran recompensa, y {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} hijos del Dios Altísimo. Porque Dios es bueno con los que nunca {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dan las gracias y con los malvados.

fr.L: Au contraire, aimez vos ennemis, et faites du bien, et prêtez sans rien espérer en retour ; et votre récompense sera grande, et vous serez {{gender:enfants|fils}} du Très-Haut, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est bon envers les ingrats et les méchants.
fr.B: Aimez plutôt vos ennemis, faites-leur du bien, et prêtez sans espérer qu’on vous rende quoi que ce soit. Alors vous recevrez une grande récompense, et vous serez {{gender:enfants|fils}} du Très-Haut, puisqu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est bon pour les ingrats et pour les méchants.
fr.R: Au contraire, aimez vos ennemis. Faites-leur du bien. Prêtez-leur, et n’attendez pas qu’on vous rende quelque chose. Alors vous aurez une grande récompense, et vous serez {{gender:enfants|fils}} du Dieu Très-Haut. Car Dieu est bon avec ceux qui ne {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} disent jamais merci, et avec ceux qui sont méchants.

sw.L: Bali wapendeni maadui wenu, na tendeni mema, na kopesheni bila kutumaini kurudishiwa chochote; na ujira wenu utakuwa mkubwa, nanyi mtakuwa wana wa Aliye Juu Kabisa, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mwema kwa wasio na shukrani na waovu.
sw.B: Badala yake, wapendeni maadui wenu, watendeeni mema, na mkopeshe bila kutarajia kurudishiwa chochote. Ndipo mtapata ujira mkubwa, nanyi mtakuwa wana wa Aliye Juu Kabisa, kwa kuwa {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mwema kwa wasio na shukrani na kwa waovu.
sw.R: Badala yake, wapendeni maadui wenu. Watendeeni mema. Wakopesheni, wala msitarajie kurudishiwa chochote. Ndipo mtakuwa na ujira mkubwa, nanyi mtakuwa wana wa Mungu Aliye Juu Kabisa. Kwa maana Mungu ni mwema kwa watu wasiomshukuru kamwe, na kwa watu waovu.

vi.L: Nhưng hãy yêu kẻ thù của các con, và làm điều tốt, và cho vay mà không mong nhận lại gì; và phần thưởng của các con sẽ lớn, và các con sẽ là con cái của Đấng Chí Cao, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhân từ đối với những kẻ vô ơn và gian ác.
vi.B: Trái lại, hãy yêu kẻ thù mình, hãy đối xử tốt với họ, và cho vay mà không mong được trả lại gì. Như vậy, các con sẽ nhận được phần thưởng lớn, và sẽ là con cái của Đấng Chí Cao, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhân từ với cả những kẻ vô ơn và độc ác.
vi.R: Trái lại, hãy yêu thương kẻ thù của mình. Hãy làm điều tốt cho họ. Hãy cho họ vay, và đừng mong được trả lại gì. Như vậy, các con sẽ nhận được phần thưởng lớn, và các con sẽ là con cái của Đức Chúa Trời Chí Cao. Vì Đức Chúa Trời nhân từ với cả những người không bao giờ cảm ơn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và với cả những người gian ác.

ko.L: 오히려 너희 원수들을 사랑하고, 선을 행하고, 아무것도 바라지 말고 꾸어 주어라. 그러면 너희의 상이 클 것이고, 너희는 지극히 높으신 분의 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}이 될 것이다. 그분은 감사할 줄 모르는 사람들과 악한 사람들에게도 친절하시기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러니 너희는 원수를 사랑하고, 그들에게 선을 베풀고, 아무것도 돌려받을 생각 없이 꾸어 주어라. 그러면 너희가 받을 상이 클 것이고, 너희는 지극히 높으신 분의 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}이 될 것이다. 그분은 감사할 줄 모르는 사람들과 악한 사람들에게도 선하시기 때문이다.
ko.R: 너희는 오히려 원수들을 사랑하여라. 그들에게 잘해 주어라. 그들에게 꾸어 주고, 아무것도 돌려받을 생각을 하지 마라. 그러면 너희는 큰 상을 받을 것이다. 그리고 너희는 지극히 높으신 하나님의 {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}이 될 것이다. 하나님께서는 하나님께 감사하지 않는 사람들과 악한 사람들에게도 친절하시기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: hoping for nothing back: expecting no return
decisions.reason: The verb usually means to give up hope. Here, after "lend" and set against 6:34, it means to hope for something in return.

decisions.choice: nothing: the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: no one, the reading of a few early manuscripts, giving "despairing of no one"
decisions.reason: A few early manuscripts have a form meaning "no one", which gives the sense "giving up on no one". Most have "nothing". Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: children of the Most High: people who share God's character
alternatives: a title earned by good works
decisions.reason: Children take after their father. Those who love their enemies act as God acts. "The Most High" is a name for God (1:32, 35; Genesis 14:18-20). The word is "sons", but the saying is for all who listen.

decisions.choice: kind: good, generous
decisions.reason: The word describes goodness that gives to those who do not deserve it.

decisions.choice: rather: a strong contrast with 6:32-34
decisions.reason: Jesus sets his command against the way sinners love, do good and lend.

decisions.choice: treat them well (B); Do good to them (R)
decisions.reason: The context shows that the enemies are the ones to whom good is done.

decisions.choice: God Most High
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that "the Most High" is God, as at 1:35.

decisions.choice: hijos, with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 5:45: Spanish "hijos" already covers sons and daughters, so the English "children|sons" setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: el Altísimo (L, B); el Dios Altísimo (R)
decisions.reason: The term used across the New Testament drafts for this name of God; Readable adds "Dios", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: wana, with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 5:45: "wana" is used of sons and daughters alike, so the English "children|sons" setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: Aliye Juu Kabisa (L, B); Mungu Aliye Juu Kabisa (R)
decisions.reason: The term used across the New Testament drafts for this name of God; Readable adds "Mungu", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "con cái của Đấng Chí Cao" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "con cái" (children) includes sons and daughters, so the English gender span has no Vietnamese counterpart, as in Mark 3:28 and Matthew 8:12. "Đấng Chí Cao" (L, B) and "Đức Chúa Trời Chí Cao" (R) as in Luke 1:32.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:자녀들|아들들}}" with "이" after the span, at every level
decisions.reason: As in the English, "sons of the Most High" means people who share God's character, men and women (meaning decision), so Korean has both words. Both forms end in "들", so one particle fits, as in Matthew 8:12 in Korean.

decisions.choice: "지극히 높으신 분" (L, B), "지극히 높으신 하나님" (R); "친절하시다" (L, R), "선하시다" (B)
decisions.reason: "지극히 높으신 분" is the form of Luke 1:32 and 1:35 in Korean. "인자하다" (kind) is avoided because it sounds like "인자", the title Son of Man.

source.text: γίνεσθε οἰκτίρμονες καθὼς ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν οἰκτίρμων ἐστίν·

records.literal_gloss: Become compassionate as the Father of you compassionate is.

en.L: Become compassionate, as your Father is compassionate.
en.B: Show compassion, as your Father shows compassion.
en.R: Have compassion for others, just as your Father has compassion.

es.L: {{plural_you:Lleguen|Llegad}} a ser compasivos, como {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Padre es compasivo.
es.B: {{plural_you:Muestren|Mostrad}} compasión, como {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Padre muestra compasión.
es.R: {{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} compasión de los demás, así como {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Padre tiene compasión.

fr.L: Devenez compatissants, comme votre Père est compatissant.
fr.B: Faites preuve de compassion, comme votre Père fait preuve de compassion.
fr.R: Ayez de la compassion pour les autres, comme votre Père a de la compassion.

sw.L: Kuweni wenye huruma, kama Baba yenu alivyo mwenye huruma.
